_summary: Per-stage offline readiness of the POST-COLLECT mission stages (couple -> outbound tow -> park -> transfer -> verify -> return) under the FULL coldwin60 key set (PRs #328-#346). Every existing offline check for the later stages PASSES on the coldwin60 config EXCEPT the transfer/verify geometry drift (a standing config issue predating #328-#346, called out under coldwin61_actions). No code regression from #328-#346 breaks a later-stage offline check; the collect-scoped keys are correctly scoped (full base brake, carried-soft free-arm exclusion, phase-budget floor, idle heartbeat) or phase-shared-by-design and flagged (preplace/place drive profile, pitch hold, world-frame tilt).
pinning_test: scripts/twin/tests/test_post_collect_stage_readiness_v1.py (18 cases, CPU-only, loads the three coldwin60 fixtures)

transfer.regression_from_328_346: none that breaks an offline check. FLAG (unvalidated, not a proven regression): the carried preplace drive profile (shoulder_pan stiff, wrists soft), the stiff place profile, the pitch hold and the world-frame preplace tilt are PHASE-keyed, so they also apply to the live_pose transfer preplace/place. No transfer-on-shelf run has ever executed with these keys, so their effect on the transfer place is unvalidated; the profile is plausibly consistent (keeps the carton level-in-world, resists the loaded-place sag). WATCH the transfer PREPLACE/PLACE on the first GPU run that clears collect.

Every always-on validator returns [] on the full config (check_activation, check_flow_consistency, check_carton_level, check_cart_placement_source, check_support_selection, check_station_full_brake, check_phase_drive_carried_soft, check_phase_drive_carried_joint_profile, check_preplace_phase_budget). suspicions_audit.station_brake_or_hold_outside_collect: CLEAR -- full base brake gated on action=='collect' AND loaded-place phase; releases for every non-arm tick. Pitch hold engages for the transfer arm phase (location-independent chassis attitude), releases before driving.
suspicions_audit.carried_soft_or_per_joint_leak: CLEAR for FREE-ARM phases (lift/tuck/transit/release/retreat/stow uniform soft, no override; the preflight refuses a carried_soft_phase naming a non-stiff phase). PHASE-SHARED into the transfer preplace/place by phase name -- flagged, not a proven regression.
suspicions_audit.world_frame_tilt_scope: phase=='preplace' only (test_preplace_leg2_level_v1); applies to the transfer preplace too (consistent with the pitch hold). Flagged.
suspicions_audit.phase_budget_shortened: CLEAR -- preplace_phase_budget = max(120, plan+margin); only RAISES the single global phase_timeout; no phase shortened.
suspicions_audit.heartbeat_alters_tow_dock_status: CLEAR -- StatusHeartbeat silent while the arm controller is idle (the whole couple/outbound/park drive); liveness-only message, no controls, never clears active, never advances sensor anchors.
suspicions_audit.preflight_refuses_or_ignores_block: CLEAR -- config_preflight PASS; every coldwin60 block validated and consumed.

coldwin61_actions.what: Align the transfer place target with the ground-truth verify bay.
coldwin61_actions.where: DATASET config (not a repo change): either (a) point scenario.transfer_bay (center_xy/dimensions_m/top_z) at the real sales-floor endcap the carton is placed on, or set runtime verify_ground_truth.bay to it; or (b) move runtime.transfer_ground_truth.target back onto scenario.transfer_bay.
coldwin61_actions.why: The carton is placed at transfer_ground_truth.target=[-3.05,4.826,0.73] (sales-floor endcap) but the vr1 ground-truth verifier checks scenario.transfer_bay center=[-2.0,16.42] (backroom bay), 11.64 m away -> verify can never confirm. check_mission_tail.py catches this today. NOT introduced by #328-#346.

coldwin61_actions.priority: WATCH -- not a config change, a GPU-run observation
coldwin61_actions.what: On the first GPU run that clears collect, watch the TRANSFER preplace/place.
coldwin61_actions.why: The carried-preplace drive profile (shoulder_pan stiff / wrists soft), the uniform-stiff place, the pitch hold and the world-frame preplace tilt are phase-keyed and therefore also shape the live_pose transfer place -- a geometry no run has exercised with these keys. If the transfer preplace swings or the place mis-levels, scope the carried phase_drive overrides + the station pitch hold to action=='collect' (keeps collect byte-identical). No change made now (no evidence of harm; the profile is plausibly consistent).
